title: Implicit Premise Detection Schema
description: Structured results of implicit premise detection in a philosophical argument.

gaps.description: Detected logical gaps in the argument

text.description: Full statement of the implicit premise

type.description: Type of implicit premise (missing universal / conceptual bridge / category jump / existential presupposition / exclusivity assumption / background framework / hidden quantification shift)

fills.description: The inferential gap this premise fills (e.g., 'P1+P2 → C')

certainty.description: Confidence that the author is committed to this implicit premise

independently_testable.description: Whether the implicit premise can be tested independently of the argument

textual_clue.description: Textual hint suggesting the author's commitment to this premise

rejection_impact.description: Impact on the argument if this implicit premise is rejected

overall_assessment.description: Overall assessment of the argument's implicitness profile

implicitness_level.description: Overall degree to which the argument relies on unstated premises

critical_vulnerability.description: Description of the most critical vulnerability among implicit premises

recommended_inspection_order.description: Ordered list of implicit premise IDs recommended for priority scrutiny
